prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1294; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid shows a crease along its lower edge, with the left taillight assembly broken at the mounting points. The damage pattern lines up well with the rear-end impact that was reported, and no earlier body damage is recorded on this vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight assembly, repairing and refinishing the trunk lid, and checking the rear panel supports for hidden deformation once the trim is removed. The labor hours on the estimate match the scope of work, and the parts and charges on the submitted invoices show no repeated items.
